reason: We have no car, so getting to the Jbeil supermarkets is a hassle and a cost. The first bag is free and pickup is at the mini-market in my village, so I would try it for the heavy staples like oil, rice, detergent and milk. I would still go buy my vegetables and meat myself.
objection: I want to choose my own vegetables and meat, and they don't do that. I also don't know yet if half the bulk saving is more than the $1.25 a bag, so I would check the slip before I keep going.
would_change_my_mind: If the slips showed the saving was usually smaller than the bag fee, I would stop after the first bag.
